title: Cross-Facility Move-In Miles — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
**Terms for moves between facilities.** On a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in claim, the cross-facility miles depend on where the claimed storage unit is, read from the facility on its Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement and the truck contract's pickup facility:

1. a unit at a facility other than the truck's pickup facility, with the truck picked up on or before the unit's move-in date, adds **25** miles;
2. a unit at another facility with the truck picked up after the unit's move-in date adds **15** miles;
3. a unit at the pickup facility adds no miles.

## Paired cases (hypothetical claimed unit moving in on 10 March)

| Claimed unit's facility | Actual pickup date | Cross-facility miles |
|---|---|---|
| Another facility | 9 March | 25 |
| Another facility | 10 March | 25 — on the move-in date counts as on or before |
| Another facility | 11 March | 15 |
| The truck's pickup facility | Any date | 0 |
